interfaces.name: Deskera Web Application (BooksPlus, CRMPlus, PeoplePlus, Go)
interfaces.classification_rationale: Persistent, navigable product UIs where the consumer expresses actions by manipulating presented affordances (views, forms, menus). Affordance Manipulation.

provenance.evidence: Official developer docs 'Production Environment' page lists UI URLs booksplus.deskera.com, crmplus.deskera.com, peopleplus.deskera.com, go.deskera.com.

interfaces.name: Deskera Mobile App
interfaces.classification_rationale: First-party mobile client using the same affordance-manipulation paradigm on a distinct mobile surface.

provenance.evidence: Official product page describing the Deskera mobile application for the workforce, syncing with the desktop backend.
App Store listing published by Deskera Holdings Ltd., confirming a first-party iOS client.
Google Play listing (com.deskera.desk) confirming a first-party Android client.

interfaces.name: Deskera REST API (Books, Sales, CRM+, People)
interfaces.classification_rationale: The consumer explicitly invokes provider-defined operations through structured HTTP requests. All product APIs share one production base and one token/OAuth auth scheme, so they form one logical interface. Operation Invocation.

provenance.evidence: Official developer documentation portal covering Books, Sales, CRM+, and People API references.
Establishes token authentication (x-access-token) and REST request/response structure common to the Deskera APIs.
Establishes a single production API base (bifrost-us.deskera.com) and OAuth token flow shared across the products.

interfaces.name: Deskera AI assistant ("David")
interfaces.classification_rationale: Actions are expressed through natural-language messages interpreted by the service (chat to retrieve financials, create transactions, get support). Tool orchestration is internal to the service and not part of the consumer-facing contract, so Conversational rather than Agentic.

provenance.evidence: Official AI product page describing chat-based interaction ('chatting with your AI', 'Ask AI to create bills and invoices', 'AI-powered chat') and the assistant 'David'.

access_mechanism_ledger.detail: Authentication mechanism, not a logical interface
No first-party native desktop client observed; desktop use is the web application in a browser
Only a community sample (deskera-cli-node-sample, a Node.js API client) exists; no provider-shipped CLI product. It wraps the REST API
No CLI product exists, so no persistent navigable TUI
No provider-defined webhook or event mechanism in the official developer docs; third-party platforms build webhooks externally around the REST API
No official Deskera-shipped MCP server; only a generic conceptual mention in a blog post
SDK that implements the REST API, not a logical interface
Internal CRM helpdesk feature, not a provider-defined service access interface
